title: About Zscaler Client Connector Integration with Deception

blocks.text: Integrating Zscaler Client Connector with Zscaler Deception enhances the ability of Zscaler Client Connector to manage the Deception process on endpoints. In the Zscaler Admin Console, you can selectively enable Deception for groups of users or devices.

While the Zscaler Admin Console receives automatic configuration updates from Deception, you can click Sync to manually update Deception configurations. You can also require a password to disable Deception. To learn more, see Deploying Endpoint Deception with Zscaler Client Connector for Windows.
